description: Verify a Washington contractor registration against the official Washington L&I open-data API by exact license number or partial business name. Returns current status, expiration, trade, registration type, UBI, locality, freshness source, and official link. Principal-person and direct-contact fields are intentionally excluded.

business_name.description: Partial registered business name, at least 2 characters.

license_number.description: Exact Washington contractor license number. Preferred when known.

name: wa_contractor_verify
